scope: Frozen date-endpoint two-hop controlled conflict challenge from an unused2Wiki development cohort. No claim about natural-conflict prevalence or all2Wiki tasks.
cost_note: Per-arm logical costs share executed calls; never sum them across arms. Source cap excludes full-source construction input and repeated reader input. Invalid and interrupted attempts are retained.
confirmation_rule: Primary two-sided paired difference joint-minus-plain; claim confirmation only if full cohort complete, difference positive,95%cluster interval excludes0 and exact p<.05. Read clean false-conflicts and all controls alongside it; do not infer strong-chain superiority from the primary.
